title: Third recurrence of local-counter-as-global-identity: LFP channel_id is probe-local in C31o
severity: blocks the C31o replication as designed
found_while: Preparing the two frozen replication sessions (replication-freeze-20260829). Found BEFORE running, not after.

the_defect.statement: omission.jnwb_ext.spk_lfp_pilot.resolve_channel_sets locates a unit's own LFP channel with sm.index[sm['channel_id'] == peak_channel_id] and takes own_rows[0]. That assumes channel_id is session-unique. It is NOT, corpus-wide.
the_defect.sub-V182o_ses-260702: channel_id 0..511, 512 unique of 512 rows -- session-unique. Equal to the electrodes table id. Everything worked.
the_defect.sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec: channel_id 0..127 repeated on all three probes -- 128 unique of 384 rows. PROBE-LOCAL.
the_defect.why_it_was_missed: The claim 'channel_id is verified session-unique' in canonical-identity-hardening-20260829 was verified on ONE session and stated without a corpus scope. That over-generalisation is the actual error; the code merely inherited it.

measured_consequences_C31o.units_silently_dropped: 255 of 357. Unit peak_channel_id is session-global (0..378, probeA 0-103 / probeB 128-255 / probeC 261-378) while LFP channel_id only reaches 127, so every unit on probeB or probeC fails to match and resolve_channel_sets returns None.
measured_consequences_C31o.units_resolved_to_the_wrong_probe: 0 today -- but only by luck of row ordering. signal_metadata is ordered probeA first, and probeA's units happen to carry peak_channel_id <= 127, so first-match lands correctly. A reordering of signal_metadata would silently substitute another probe's channel with no error.
measured_consequences_C31o.effect_on_the_replication: Only 8 of the 40 selected units survive to analysis, against 40 of 40 for sub-V182o_ses-260629. Running C31o in this state would produce an underpowered result that looks like a biological difference between subjects.

root_cause.finding: Unit peak_channel_id is a row index into the NWB electrodes table, which is session-global and unique in BOTH sessions (V182o id 0..511 of 512 rows; C31o id 0..383 of 384 rows). It is signal_metadata's channel_id COLUMN that is probe-local for C31o.
root_cause.verified_row_correspondence: signal_metadata row i corresponds to electrodes row i in both sessions: row counts equal (512/512, 384/384) and the probe sequence is identical element-for-element.

proposed_fix.change: Resolve the unit's own channel by ROW POSITION into signal_metadata (which equals the electrodes id, which equals peak_channel_id) instead of by matching the channel_id column.
proposed_fix.why_it_preserves_the_freeze: For sub-V182o_ses-260702 channel_id IS the electrode id in row order, so row-position lookup returns exactly the same channel for every unit. The fix is provably a no-op on the session where the estimator was validated, and the pilot numbers would not move.
proposed_fix.status: NOT APPLIED. Hamm froze the pipeline on 2026-08-29 with 'Do not change the model now.' This is a correctness defect rather than an estimator or threshold change, but it does touch frozen code, so it is recorded and held pending his decision rather than patched silently.

dead_end_recorded_so_it_is_not_retried: The obvious alternative key -- the units table's own local_index column -- is NOT a channel index. In sub-V182o_ses-260702 it ranges 0..134 (beyond the 128-channel probe) and equals the kilosort unit_id on probeA, i.e. it is a per-probe UNIT counter. sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec has no local_index on units at all.

instances: trial_num -- per-block trial counter; deduplication deleted 63 real trials
unit_id -- per-probe kilosort counter; template join mislabelled 6 units and their areas
channel_id -- probe-local in C31o; 255 of 357 units silently dropped
pattern.lesson: The gates added in canonical-identity-hardening-20260829 cover trials and units. They did NOT cover channels against a MULTI-SESSION corpus: assert_unique_channels keys on (session, probe, local_index), which holds in both sessions and therefore passed while the actual consumer keyed on channel_id. A gate that tests a different key from the one the code uses does not protect the code.
pattern.generalisation: Verify identity semantics against MORE THAN ONE session before recording them as a corpus property. Every previous instance was found by a session that behaved differently from the one the assumption was formed on.

receipts.id_spaces: V182o: unit peak_channel_id 2..511 over 234 distinct, LFP channel_id 0..511 n=512, overlap 234/234, units resolvable 409/409. C31o: unit peak_channel_id 0..378 over 168 distinct, LFP channel_id 0..127 n=384, overlap 44/168, units resolvable 102/357.
receipts.per_probe_ranges_C31o: LFP channel_id per probe: A (0,127) B (0,127) C (0,127). Unit peak_channel_id per probe: A (0,103) B (128,255) C (261,378).
receipts.selection_impact: Of the 40 units selected under the frozen protocol: sub-V182o_ses-260629 0 skipped; sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec 32 skipped for absent peak channel, 0 for spike count.
